name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a Qiskit program testing the 3-qubit Me
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a Qiskit program testing the 3-qubit Mermin inequality on a GHZ state: estimate <XXX>, <XYY>, <YXY>, <YYX> with StatevectorEstimator and show M = <XXX> - <XYY> - <YXY> - <YYX> reaches 4 (classical bound 2). Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
